en.headline: Cavalluna horses settle in at Kai Tak ahead of Tuesday opening
en.dek: Fifty-four European horses arrived this week for eight performances of the equestrian theatre show at Kai Tak Arena from 8 to 13 September.
body: Horses for Cavalluna – Gate to the Otherworld were flown from Belgium and moved to Kai Tak Sports Park this week, the park and the Hong Kong Jockey Club said, as crews prepare for the show’s Asian debut on Tuesday.

Kai Tak Sports Park lists eight performances at Kai Tak Arena (Grand Hall) on 8 September and from 10 to 13 September. Showtimes published by HK Ticketing are 7pm on 8 and 10 September; 3pm and 8pm on 11 September; 2pm and 7pm on 12 September; and 1pm and 6pm on 13 September. The Jockey Club is the exclusive presenting partner and cultural host; it said it sent seven horse transporters and 10 stable hands to move the animals from the airport.

The production, staged by Apassionata World, uses 54 horses, including Lusitanos, Spanish Andalusians, Friesians, Arabians and mini ponies, with riders, dancers and a storyline scored by Emmy-nominated composer Klaus Hillebrecht. Organisers say the show has previously toured more than 30 European cities.

Tickets are sold through HK Ticketing. Listed prices range from HK$395 for Category 3 seats to HK$1,995 for the first row, with accessible seats at HK$895 and a six-seat VIP table at HK$27,220, excluding a customer service fee. The park and ticketing site do not list an age limit on the event page.

zh.headline: 歐洲馬術劇場名駒抵港 啟德體藝館週二首演
zh.dek: 54匹歐洲馬匹本周運抵啟德體育園，《CAVALLUNA 穿梭異境》將於9月8日至13日上演八場。
body: 啟德體育園及香港賽馬會表示，歐洲馬術劇場《CAVALLUNA – Gate to the Otherworld 穿梭異境》的馬匹已由比利時空運抵港，並遷入啟德體育園，為星期二的亞洲首演作準備。
啟德體育園公布，演出於啟德體藝館主場館舉行，日期為9月8日及10日至13日，共八場。快達票列出的開場時間為8日及10日晚上7時、11日下午3時及晚上8時、12日下午2時及晚上7時，以及13日下午1時及晚上6時。馬會為獨家呈獻機構及文化主辦單位，並派出七輛運馬車及10名馬房助理，由機場接載馬匹。
製作由 Apassionata World 推出，演出陣容包括54匹馬，當中有盧西塔諾馬、西班牙安達盧西亞馬、弗里斯蘭馬、阿拉伯馬及迷你小馬，並有騎手、舞團及由曾獲艾美獎提名的 Klaus Hillebrecht 創作的故事音樂。主辦單位指節目曾在歐洲逾30個城市巡演。
門票經快達票發售。標價由第3類座位395港元至首行1,995港元不等，無障礙座位895港元，六人貴賓桌27,220港元，另加客戶服務費。場地及售票頁未列明年齡限制。
